$comment: Framework source files already over the 500-line cap of no_oversized_python_files, and the lines each holds. A RATCHET, because the rule's finding is one per file however long it grows: a recorded file may shrink and never grow, and one that shrinks lowers its number in the same change. A file back under the cap leaves the record, and nothing new may join: split a file before it reaches the cap. Held by tests/architecture/test_framework_package_arch.py.
